purpose: Describe doing several things or handling an amount at one time.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I took three tablets at one time.
I cannot hear if everyone speaks at once.
It is difficult to carry all the luggage in one trip.
restrictions: Contrasts one combined occasion with separate stages.
mistake: 一度に is at one time; 一度だけ is only once.
